name: PayPal Payment Gateway
description: PayPal checkout for every Kohevo module that takes payments (Shop, Booking, Membership, website payment buttons, …) through the shared Payments layer. One-time payments (PayPal Orders) and monthly / yearly payments (PayPal Subscriptions), refunds from Payments → Transactions, and signed webhooks so a payment is recorded even when the customer never comes back.
author: Kohevo

permissions.label: Manage PayPal gateway settings and API credentials
